kpis.name: Service / Subscription / ARR Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue from subscriptions to its HCM software, renewable annually.
kpis.description: ADP derives nearly all of its revenue from recurring services (software, outsourced services), ensuring high predictability.
kpis.signal: Recurring base growing, revenue visibility rising

kpis.name: Total Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue — total sales generated over the period.
kpis.description: Total revenues of $20,560.9M in 2025, 7% growth on reported and organic constant currency basis, fueled by new subscriptions, customer retention, increased interest income on client funds and the WorkForce Software acquisition.

kpis.name: Operating Margin
kpis.description: EBIT Margin at 25.8% in 2025 vs 25.4% in 2024, 50 bps expansion; Adjusted EBIT Margin at 26.0% in 2025 vs 25.5% in 2024. Improvement driven by productivity and scale gains.

kpis.name: Gross Margin
kpis.explanation: Gross Margin — gross profit divided by revenue.
kpis.description: Calculated from: (Total Revenues $20,560.9M - Total costs of revenues $11,097.3M) / $20,560.9M = 46.1%. Demonstrates a highly profitable software/services model.

kpis.name: R&D as % of Revenue
kpis.description: R&D at $988.6M in 2025 vs $955.7M in 2024 ($988.6 / $20,560.9 = 4.81%); rising with ADP Lyric HCM development, WorkForce Software integration, and deployment of AI tools in R&D.

kpis.name: Total Assets

kpis.description: Total assets extracted from yfinance over the last 4 years.

kpis.name: Total Debt

kpis.description: Total debt extracted from yfinance over the last 4 years.

kpis.name: Cash And Cash Equivalents
kpis.description: Cash and equivalents extracted from yfinance over the last 4 years.

kpis.name: Dividend Per Share
kpis.explanation: Dividend Per Share — total dividends paid divided by shares outstanding.
kpis.description: Dividend per share paid annually, aggregated from yfinance.dividends over the last 7 fiscal years reported by the company.
kpis.signal: Dividend cut risk, monitor payout sustainability

kpis.name: Capital Returned (Dividends)
kpis.explanation: Capital Return — total cash returned to shareholders (dividends + buybacks).
kpis.description: Capital returned to shareholders via annual dividends, extracted from yfinance.cashflow over the last 4 reported fiscal years.

kpis.name: Payout Ratio
kpis.explanation: Payout Ratio — dividends paid divided by net income.
kpis.description: Payout ratio = Dividends paid / Net income, calculated over the last 4 fiscal years from yfinance.cashflow and yfinance.income_stmt.
kpis.signal: Shareholder returns growing, dividend policy supportive

company_description: Automatic Data Processing, Inc. provides cloud-based human capital management (HCM) solutions worldwide. It operates in two segments, Employer Services and Professional Employer Organization (PEO). The Employer Services segment offers strategic, cloud-based platforms, and human resources (HR) outsourcing solutions. This segment's offerings include RUN Powered by ADP, a software platform for small business payroll, HR, and compliance; ADP Workforce Now, a HCM solution used across mid-sized and large businesses to manage employees; and ADP Lyric HCM, a solution for HR management, payroll, workforce management, talent, and data analytics. The PEO Services segment provides HR and employment administration outsourcing solutions under ADP TotalSource name to businesses through a co-employment model. The segment also provides guidance, user-friendly technology, comprehensive employee benefits, and a risk management, safety, and workers' compensation program. The company was founded in 1949 and is headquartered in Roseland, New Jersey.
